This historic diplomatic pivot suggests a significant cooling of relations between the US and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, as the administration prioritizes regional de-escalation and economic engagement over traditional military posturing. The orders authorize the Department of State and Treasury to initiate frameworks for trade, potentially ending decades of economic deadlock. As Trump reshapes the Middle Eastern geopolitical map, global markets and allies are closely monitoring the implications for global oil prices and the future of the US-Israel security alliance.

recentItems.title: Horrific Scenes In Ukraine Mall As Russia Unleashes Hell In Zaporizhzhia, Shopping Complex Burns
recentItems.description:
Horrific Scenes In Ukraine Mall As Russia Unleashes Hell In Zaporizhzhia, Shopping Complex Burns

Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said Friday a Russian drone attack hit a shopping complex in Zaporizhzhia, injuring one person. The attack sparked a fire that spread across over 10,000 square meters, the service said in a statement on Telegram. Video from the Zaporizhzhia Regional State Emergency Service showed a burning mall engulfed in flames as firefighters worked to extinguish it. Emergency crews extinguished the blaze, but their work was complicated by the threat of further Russian attacks, forcing firefighters to periodically take shelter.
